mapper.select:
SELECT t.id AS sku_id, t.`img` , t.`name` , t.`spu_id` , t.`supply_price` , t.`sale_attribute` as sale_attribute_json, t.`sale_price`, t.out_sku_id as outSkuId, t.buy_start_qty, t.`expand` as expand,
MAX(IF(t1.id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) as is_select,
MAX(t1.sell_price) as store_price,
t2.account_id as supplier_id, t2.freight_template_id, t2.state as spu_state, t2.img as spu_img, t2.name as spu_name, t2.out_spu_id as outSpuId, t2.channel_type as spu_channel_type FROM sku t
LEFT JOIN market_goods_relation t1 ON t.spu_id = t1.goods_id
LEFT JOIN store_goods t1 ON t.id = t1.sku_id
LEFT JOIN spu t2 on t.spu_id = t2.id
and t1.user_id = #{channelId} and t1.relation_type = 3 and t1.state = 1
and t1.channel_id = #{channelId} and t1.store_id = #{storeId}
and t.id in
#{item.skuId}
GROUP BY t.id, t.spu_id

SELECT t.id AS sku_id, t.`img` , t.`name` , t.`spu_id` , t.`supply_price` , t.`sale_attribute` as sale_attribute_json, t.`sale_price`, t.out_sku_id as outSkuId, t2.account_id as supplier_id, t2.freight_template_id, t2.state as spu_state, t2.img as spu_img, t2.name as spu_name, t2.out_spu_id as outSpuId, t2.channel_type as spu_channel_type, t.buy_start_qty, t.expand FROM sku t LEFT JOIN spu t2 on t.spu_id = t2.id where t.id in
#{item}
